summary: Iteration 15: tested the ebook free sample (GET /api/me/book/sample and the /book SampleBox) and the Interview Ready badge (Analyst level, earned from a purchase) across /api/me/badges, /api/dashboard, the share card, the dashboard EbookCard, /app/badges and the landing showcase. Also re-checked /book price, Udemy link and the disabled pay buttons. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed, plus 1 skipped because no PDF library is installed; the 10-page count was confirmed by parsing the PDF directly (/Count 10). Frontend: all flows passed. No functional bugs found.

integration_issues.issue: Like the full reader (see iteration 14), the iframe src and the open-tab href call /api/me/book/sample directly with the cookie only. If the 15-min access token has expired they return 401 JSON instead of the PDF. Low priority.

issues: The Analyst section is a 2-column grid, so the 3rd card (Interview Ready) sits alone on a second row. Acceptable, but uneven next to Recruit.

action_items: Optional: refresh the token, or fetch as a blob, before loading the sample/full PDF in the iframe or new tab
critical_code_review_comments: routes_book.book_sample: auth-gated through get_current_user, so any logged-in user can read it. Serves a separate 10-page sample.pdf (2.56MB, inline, no-store), so the full book is never exposed. Non-buyers still get 402 on /me/book/file (verified).
compute_badges: interview-ready comes only from db.purchases. Admins own the book through their role but correctly do NOT earn the badge (verified).

The share card PNG renders at 1200px with the interview-ready character, the 'ANALYST LEVEL' label and the description 'Buy the SOC Interview Preparation ebook'. The public OG page includes 'Interview Ready' and 'Analyst'.

Not caused by this feature: the demo student has lab-rat earned and levelups_seen=[], so the Hunter LevelUpReveal overlay shows on every dashboard visit until dismissed. Tests have to close it ([data-testid=level-up-close] / Escape) before clicking the dashboard.
seed_data_creation: Inserted db.purchases rows temporarily (TEST_purchase in pytest, TEST_ui_purchase for UI); both removed, so purchases is empty again. A TEST_ user created in pytest was deleted. Student levelups_seen was reset back to [] after closing the reveal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment keys are intentionally unconfigured (disabled buttons expected). Headless Chromium shows PDF iframes as blank white; the network shows 200 application/pdf. Login from /book's sample login link returns to /book. Next badge for the demo student is On Fire, so interview-ready only becomes 'next' once first-blood, on-fire, triage-pro and quiz-master are all earned (ORDER logic checked in code). The demo student shows a Hunter level-up reveal overlay on /app; close it first.
